objective: Strengthen the T2' exclusion certificate by (a) lifting maxcoeff from 10^4 to 10^6 on the existing 60-element (3,2) tensor basis (coefficient-floor axis), and (b) extending V_quad-degree from 3 to 4 on the same classical generators at maxcoeff=10^4 (degree-extension axis). Closes two of the three named falsification triggers from the T2' handoff in one Tier-3b session.
rationale_for_dual_axis: Claude's relay text named bipartite (3,3) tensor at maxcoeff=10^6 as the highest-information-per-cycle next step, citing 40 elements and ~T2' runtime. On the 4-classical-generator basis used by T2', the strict (3,3) tensor is 4*35 = 140 elements with ~5-8h wall-clock at maxcoeff=10^6, breaking the stated 'one Tier-3b session' budget. The dual-axis option below tests the same two underlying experimental dimensions (coefficient ceiling AND V_quad-degree extension) within the budget, on the basis where a relation is most likely to live. The strict (3,3) cycle is deferred.
